name: PowerShell Script Dropped Via PowerShell.EXE
description: Detects PowerShell creating a PowerShell file (.ps1). While often times this behavior is benign, sometimes it can be a sign of a dropper script trying to achieve persistence.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: False positives will differ depending on the environment and scripts used. Apply additional filters accordingly.
query: ((process.executable:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe)) AND file.path:*.ps1) AND (NOT (file.path:*__PSScriptPolicyTest_* OR (file.path:C\:\\Users\\* AND file.path:*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*) OR file.path:C\:\\Windows\\Temp\\*))
